_comment: Base allow-list is intentionally stack-agnostic — only universal, read-only, non-destructive commands. Add stack-specific entries (npm/yarn/pnpm, pip/poetry, go, cargo, docker, etc.) when this template is copied into an actual project. Never add destructive commands (rm -rf, git push --force, db migrate down, etc.) to 'allow' — those should prompt every time.
